For this ordinary-passport tourist route, complete MDAC unless you hold Malaysian permanent residence or a Malaysian long-term pass. Diplomatic and official passports have a separate exemption. The published MDAC exemption list does not contain a child-under-three exemption.
HKSAR passport holders must select Hong Kong as their nationality when completing MDAC.
